Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
Hi !
two players remain on a table. They are both at 2 pool.

Methuselah 1 has a Fame on his vampire. He sends him on a computer hacking,
daring the dawn, so the action is unblocked. What happens ?
my guess is : the bleed passes. The Methuselah 2 loses 2 pool, so is ousted.
Methuselah 1 gains 1 vp and 6 pool for the oust. Then the daring resolves
and methuselah 1 loses 3 pool. Then he's the last man standing and gains
another VP. Game ends.

is this correct ?

Now consider the same situation but a political flux called earlier has
determined that the next oust will bring only one pool.
Methuselah 1 sends his Famous vamp hacking daring the dawn anyway. What
happens ?
my guess is : the bleed resolves, meth 2 loses 2 pool, is ousted. Meth 1
gains 1 vp and 1 pool for the oust. Then Daring the dawn resolves and
methuselah 1 loses 3 pool, being also ousted in the process. Game ends with
one VP lost in the void.

is this correct ?

reyda

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 11 Aug 2003 12:16:13 +0200, "Reyda" <true_...@hotmail.com>
scrawled:



Vampire hacks with daring the dawn, methuselah 2 is ousted. Game ends.
No pool is given. The game is over. You don't put the vamp in torpor,
because there is no vamp, because there is no longer a game.
Methuselah 1 gets 1 vp for ousting methuselah 2, plus 1 vp for being
last person in the game.

Also, unless methuselah 1 is a psycho, the Fame would burn when it's
controller is ousted, in this case presumably methuselah 2. :)
Not that it matters.

salem

original controller, then goes to torpor...

way to decrease the cost/value of that vampire... But how to use
it... =D

1... once there is only 1 player on the table... the table is done,
regardless... Be silly to continue to play chess once you got them in
a checkmate...
2... Daring the dawn agg damage happens after the completion of the
action...
Since the action itself ends the game... Why resolve it...

The only thing I can think of is, that your not the last 2...
Then you gain the 6 pool the moment your prey is ousted...
Then after the action is complete, then the daring the dawn agg damage
takes affect...
